must_identify.item: The api cannot reach redis (connection timeouts), which is why /api/ returns 5xx; redis itself is healthy
The cause is the NetworkPolicy redis, which allows ingress to redis only from app=worker, not from the api

notes: The investigator ran no commands and reported 'No problems detected', even though a critical alert shows 100% 5xx on /api/. Check whether the investigator failed to run or had a tooling or permission problem, because this looks like a pipeline failure rather than a reasoned conclusion.
